This screen shows information about your opponent and the rewards for winning the battle.
Tap to start the battle
This is the prep phase. You can see the enemy's formation here.
Tap to view the enemy unit's details
This is the Pokemon's name
This is the Pokemon's Attack, which determines how much damage it deals when attacking
This is the Pokemon's HP, which determines how much damage it can take before it is knocked out
This is the Pokemon's star level. Its power increases as its star level goes up
These are the Pokemon's natures. Different Trainers prefer different natures
Tap to close the details
Tap to start the battle

Pokemon damage rule 1: When making a basic attack, the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B# and the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B# clash, and the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B# takes damage equal to the Attack of the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B#
#C0xF13B54#Charmander#C0x5B545B# will deal 3 damage to #C0x3D8A99#Bulbasaur#C0x5B545B#

Pokemon damage rule 2: Then the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B# takes counter damage equal to the Attack of the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B#
#C0xF13B54#Charmander#C0x5B545B# will take 2 counter damage from #C0x3D8A99#Bulbasaur#C0x5B545B#
Pokemon damage rule 3: When a card's HP drops to 0, that card is knocked out

Trainer damage rule 1: When one side has no units left on the field, the game ends
The winner deals damage to the losing Trainer (damage = total star level of the winner's units on the field + the Trainer's base damage)
Reduce the enemy Trainer's HP to 0 to win the battle
Look, we won this battle and earned 3 gold, so now we can buy a new Pokemon
Tap to close the results screen

After the battle ends, all of your Pokemon recover their status
Non-permanent buffs gained during battle are not kept

Hello, Trainer. Welcome to card duels. Before we begin, you need to pass a small trial.
Before entering battle, you first need to choose a Trainer role.
Read each Trainer's skill carefully, then choose a Trainer
After choosing, tap Ready. (Rotom tip: Even after tapping Ready, you can still switch your Trainer selection.)

The left side lists the players in this match. #C0x3D8A99#Blue marks the Trainer you control#C0x5B545B#, and #C0xF13B54#Red marks the Trainer you will battle this round#C0x5B545B# (Rotom tip: In a full match, 6 players compete at the same time.)
This shows the current round number
The top-right area shows how much gold you currently have and how much you will gain at the start of the next round

limitHint: Tap the button to upgrade the shop
talkContent: Use the remaining gold to upgrade the shop. It will help us find stronger partners. At the start of the next round, the shop offerings will refresh automatically
Tap the Ready button and get ready for the first battle

Action order: When multiple Pokemon are battling, the leftmost Pokemon acts first, and turns proceed from left to right; if there are two leftmost Pokemon, the one with the higher total stats acts first

Pokemon damage rule 1: When making a basic attack, the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B# and the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B# clash, and the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B# takes damage equal to the Attack of the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B#. Doduo will deal 1 damage to Azurill
Pokemon damage rule 2: Then the #C0xF13B54#attacker#C0x5B545B# takes counter damage equal to the Attack of the #C0x3D8A99#defender#C0x5B545B#. Doduo takes 1 counter damage from Azurill
Pokemon damage rule 3: When a Pokemon's HP drops to 0, it temporarily leaves the field, and your lineup is restored at the start of the next round

Trainer damage rule 1: When one side has no units left on the field, the battle phase ends
The winner deals damage to the losing Trainer (damage = total star level of the winner's units on the field + the winner's shop level)
When a Trainer's HP reaches 0, they are eliminated and their final placement is settled
Great! We won the first battle and earned more gold
